finals.race: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Once-useful stayer who has run well both previous starts here (including a win). Confirmed return to form with fairly useful 2½-length second of 6 at Southwell (16.5f) last time, typically hung under pressure. Potential for a slowly-run race doesn't look ideal back down in trip, though.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Shaped much better than the result after a very slow start in a Leicester novice (7f) on debut. Built on that promise at the second attempt when second of 12 in maiden at Brighton 18 days ago and he arrives with his yard in top form. Makes plenty of appeal in this contest.

finals.race: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Fillies' Handicap
finals.comment: Belatedly doubled her tally in handicap at Leicester on first outing last month, though was helped by being held up in a strongly-run race. Failed to repeat that effort when seventh of 18 at Redcar 17 days ago.
Still a maiden but he ran creditably enough on his return from 8 months off at Fontwell (2¼m, good to soft) 18 days ago. Others still make greater appeal for win purposes, though.

Won 4 summer handicap hurdles on the bounce in 2025. Another fruitful spell when completing a quick-fire Flat hat-trick in July of this year. Jumped much better under an attacking ride when runner-up here (2m) last time. Back up in trip and may not get his own way in a more competitive affair.

Capped a fine 12 months (including 3 chase wins) when comfortably justifying support in a 5-runner handicap hurdle at Plumpton (3¼m) in May. Shaped as if better for the outing on last month's return over hurdles at Uttoxeter and he makes plenty of appeal with yard's jumpers in great form.

finals.race: Final Fence Open 30th November Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Looked a nice prospect when following up bumper success on hurdling debut in maiden over this C&D in December. Well below that level in a trio of handicaps, leaving Gary & Josh Moore after final outing, but he looks interesting starting out for new yard.

finals.race: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Mares' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Bred to be fairly useful (dam stayed 3m). Didn't go with much fluency when well held in a bumper (prominent in the betting) and 3 hurdle starts last season. Needs a close look in the market now switched to a longer trip/handicap on return.

finals.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
finals.comment: Returned to form from out of the blue when running out an 80/1 winner at Lingfield in February. Creditable in-the-frame efforts next 2 starts and shaped as if he'd come on for last month's reappearance/stable debut fifth over 8.6f here 10 days ago. One to bear in mind.

finals.race: All Weather Championship Is Back Handicap (Div 1)
finals.comment: Progressive son of Mohaather who resumed progress after 6 weeks off when landing 10-runner handicap at Musselburgh over this trip in August. Raced closer to the pace than ideal when fifth at Chester (7f, soft) a month later and he's well worth another chance making all-weather debut.

finals.race: All Weather Championship Is Back Handicap (Div 2)
finals.comment: A fair 6f maiden winner at 2 yrs. Resumed with very good second in 6f Pontefract handicap in April but failed to build on that in 4 subsequent runs, disappointing starting out for new yard (gelded) when eighth of 9 at Newmarket (6f) 44 days ago. Cheekpieces go on and too soon to write him off.

finals.race: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Nursery
finals.comment: Fair 5f Catterick nursery winner for David Loughnane in July. Has beaten only one home in 3 races since though, easy to back and very slowly away when last of 7 on debut for James Owen at Nottingham (5f, heavy) 5 days ago. Could offer more back down in class now.

finals.race: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Sent off 4/1 but never a threat after a slow start when fifth of 7 in maiden at Leicester (1¼m, good to firm) on debut 42 days ago. This well-related Saxon Warrior filly can do better.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Handicap
finals.comment: Maiden who was back to form when third in 7f handicap here but came in last of 5 (in first-time cheekpieces) in handicap at Windsor (1m, good to firm) later in June on final start for Henry Candy. Starts out with James Owen after a break and very interesting.
Failed to win for Tim Easterby but gradually going the right way for shrewd yard and posted a good third of 10 in handicap over C&D 10 days ago. Very much one to consider from an easing mark.

dropped.race: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Fillies' Handicap
dropped.comment: Made it third time lucky at Chepstow (7f) last summer and worked her way back to form this season when finishing third in handicap at Redcar (1m) in August. However, with cheekpieces applied she wasn't in the same form making all-weather debut at Lingfield last time.

dropped.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Handicap
dropped.comment: Really caught the eye on handicap debut when fourth at Haydock (1m) in May but twice failed to build on it, first-time cheekpieces/tongue tie on when beating only one at Southwell (1m) in July on final run for Dr Richard Newland & Jamie Insole. Suspect he can do better after a break for new trainer.
